name: @feldspar/app-constructor
title: App Constructor (Plan & build)
description: Describe an application in a few paragraphs, and let agents plan it in phases and build it task by task, with you reviewing each step.
supplies: Eight tables: ac_constructions (one per application, with its specification and where its run is), ac_phases and ac_tasks (the plan and its tasks), ac_mockups, ac_questions and ac_feedback (what the construction gathered from you on the way), ac_runs (the agent runs it started) and ac_errors (every error it met).

The Plan & build screen on each React application, an agent trait `constructor` with the construction agent's planning tools, and a service that runs each construction's tasks with the construction agent and the application's builder agent.
